## Problem

What pain or use-case does this address? (e.g. "the agent can't read PDFs")

## Proposed behavior

Describe the feature. If it is a **new skill action**, sketch its name,
inputs, and the risk class it should carry (`low` / `medium` / `high`).

## Alternatives

What other approaches did you consider?

## Acceptance criteria

How would we verify it works?

- [ ] e.g. `pytest tests/...`
- [ ] e.g. `python scripts/smoke.py` still green

## Notes

Anything else (links, screenshots, related work).
